notes_for_us: Every option in this build came from the preset and none from the prompt, while everything the prompt actually asked for - trees, flowers - had to ship as free text. That inversion is the clearest single measurement in my batch: the option catalogue has no vegetation row at all, so the most common request in nature prompts cannot be a pick.

'Peaceful' is a negative requirement - no hazards, no enemies, no pressure - and constraints only holds fidelity, build_rule and reference. I read it as theme, but a build that ignores it and adds a wolf has not violated anything in the handoff.
